msMoneyImport.pageDescription: Bring your accounts, categories and transactions across from a Microsoft Money .mny file.

fileUpload.description: Pick the .mny file Microsoft Money saved on your computer.
fileUpload.passwordHint: Leave blank unless you set a password in Microsoft Money.

errors.passwordUnsupportedChars: This password contains characters we can't send. Try a password without emoji or non-Latin letters.

errors.uploadUnavailable: The uploaded file is no longer available. Please upload your Money file again.

resolve.prepareFailed: Could not prepare the account and category mapping. Reload the page and try again.

accounts.currentBalancePlaceholder: Leave blank to use the imported total
accounts.skippedNote: {count} account(s) will be skipped. Their transactions — and any transfers to or from them — will not be imported.

tooltips.mapExactMatchesAccounts: Link every account whose name exactly matches one you already have.
tooltips.mapExactMatchesCategories: Link every category whose name exactly matches one you already have.
tooltips.createNewForUnmatched: Set every undecided row to "create new".
tooltips.reset: Clear all choices and match again.

review.warningsHint: These rows are not part of the import.

warnings.rowLimitReached: {count} transaction(s) over the limit were dropped
warnings.accountCurrencyDefaulted: {count} account(s) had no currency in the file, so USD was assumed — check the currency on the accounts step before continuing
warnings.rowMissingDate: {count} transaction(s) with no readable date were skipped
warnings.rowAmountUnreadable: {count} transaction(s) with no readable amount were skipped

includeVoided.label: Import {count} voided transaction(s)
includeVoided.hint: Microsoft Money keeps voided entries in the register but never applies them to your balance, so they're imported at zero and tagged "Void" — keeping their date, payee, category, memo and cheque number.

review.duplicatesHint: These already look like transactions you have. Check a row to import it anyway; unchecked duplicates are skipped.

execute.partialImportNote: Some transactions may already have been imported.

done.successDescription: Everything from your Money file is now in your account.
done.partialDescription: Most rows landed. The list below shows what didn't.
done.emptyDescription: Every row was either skipped or already in your ledger, so no transactions were created.
done.allFailedDescription: No transactions could be created. See the errors below.
done.balanceWarningBody: We couldn't set the final balance on every account. Check them and adjust if needed.

leaseExpired.title: Your uploaded file is no longer available
leaseExpired.description: The parsed copy of your Money file was released after a period of inactivity. Your mapping choices could not be kept, so the import needs to start from the upload step again.
